english.note: Use this when the thing is inspirational because it gives people ideas or insight, especially a book, talk, or discussion.

examples.english: This book is very inspirational and gave me new ideas about raising children.
examples.traditional: 呢本書好有啟發性，令我對教仔有新諗法。
